statement: The SSSL window pattern fixes the ratio of local to global attention layers at 3:1 by convention rather than by measurement at this depth and width.

scope.model: decoder-only transformer, 8 layers, d_model 512, 4 heads of 128
scope.budget: 300 charged training seconds on one H200

metrics.name: val_bpb
metrics.result: window_pattern is a plain string constant in GPTConfig and no ablation of it exists in this campaign's records. Changing the ratio changes both the attention FLOP profile and the depth at which global mixing first occurs, which are separable effects.
